title: Bound grouped Type B rank-137 root splits
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On the exact signed #7113 caller, Type B roots 36 and 37 have the same rank-137 diagonal. Hold the paid itinerary fixed and grant any invertible body-independent central-even basis mixing only those two inputs. Every proper nonempty squarefree first body and both parities are excluded at all 4,784 literal cuts.

Forward exact minors cover 1,254,077,760 cut/mask/parity keys symbolically, with 4,883 explicit residual class deletions per sector. The independent reverse replay reconstructs both original columns in both sectors, verifies each forward minor and checks all 50,899 present classes per sector by Gram determinants. Every residual rank is two. Zero survivors and unresolved cases in the declared scope.

Before J9 at cut 3058, the fixed even rank-64 plus rank-73 split has forbidden determinants 1/2 and −i/2. Its projected gross was 2.71635078086046223–2.71635078086046224 raw across eight ports. A new rank-one job per port costs eight raw. No split was realized.

## Exact sources and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestors.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-b-rank137-grouped-bound/replay.py
```

Expect `PASS_TYPE_B_RANK137_GROUPED_BOUND`. Discovery runs finished within 30 seconds each. Registered replays give the all-cut engines 120 seconds and compare deterministic receipts. Direct, registered, read-only Git-free export, committed source/mode/history and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on the identical tree.

OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

Different input groups, timing and paid suppliers remain open. A next test needs a named earlier encoding or paid arrival that supplies the missing body and phase direction. No suffix, physical or complete application gate was reached.
